No augs on this one... hold on. Li Bei Wen? The chemist?
Hehe, I'll probably get a bonus from the corporate rep for closing this case.
The bounty's yours. We'll take the body.
Wait. I know this face. {0}, from the wanted list.
That gun is for Augs, Shopkeeper. Point it at a citizen again and we'll have a very different conversation.
But nobody's going to lose sleep over a dangerous criminal. We'll log it as a capture. The bounty's yours.
That includes the shotgun. Hand it over.
Your weapon permit covers the shotgun. Keep it, for self defence.
Yo, Boss! Got my hands on some extra gear I don't really need.
See anything you like?
Take the whole haul, and I'll give you a sweet 33% off!
Tch... Hey, seriously?! That's dirty!
FREEZE! That's the crazy girl who's been ambushing our officers!
Put your hands up and come with us, quiet and easy!
Whoa whoa, hold up! Don't be so cold-hearted, Boss~
Let it slide just this once, and I'll keep bringing you all the prime Security "loot" you could ever want!
With your connections, you'll make a killing off it. We're a team, right?
Hey~ Miss me? I'm back with another haul.
Just "borrowed" some surplus gear from those poor Security chumps again.
Usual rules. Care to pick out a few favorites?
Phew... I just got back from "sourcing ingredients" deep in the Abandoned Sections.
Found some remarkably tender cuts this time. Come take a closer look, won't you?
If you take all this meat off my hands... I'll give you a special 25% discount.
Hehe... those little cages won't keep me for long. Once I'm out, I'll be coming straight back... to carve out the sweetest cuts of *your* meat.
Shit! This crazy woman's strength is insane! Her eyes are completely dead! Get more people in here NOW!
Hehe, we meet again. See? I brought back some fresh, warm "meat" just for you.
Oh my... are you really sure you want to do that, my dear "shopkeep"?
Meat this soft and fresh doesn't come easy... someone always has to bleed for it, you know?
I do the carving, you do the selling. Be a good boy and don't ask whose bones it came off of, alright?
That crazy butcher girl with the cleaver has been targeting my crew as well.
You'd better keep a gun close, sweetheart.
I'm very, very patient... The moment you step outside your door, I'll be watching you from the dark.
Hehe... sooner or later, you'll have to come out into my arms.
Need a sharper cleaver. The old one got notched hacking through all those bones.
Sawyer's crew paid {0} a visit last night. She will not be selling anyone's fresh meat ever again.
Hey, I heard you've got a problem with {0}.
How about you chip in {0} Credits, and my crew will take care of that troublesome butcher for you?
You can pay through the Nightly Service terminal whenever you're ready.
Sharp Meat Cleaver
Anonymous Chef
Your store has been vandalized. Someone painted "MEAT" across the front... in fresh blood!?
You feel an empty, chilling gaze watching you from the shadows. Good thing you brought a gun.
Butcher Girl Hunting Service
Scavenger's journal entry

Here I am, deep in the Abandoned Sections. Everywhere else on the station has been picked clean, but this place... it's different. I've heard the rumors about that cleaver-wielding girl, but so far, the loot's been good. Still, there's a heavy stench of raw meat in the air, like a hungry predator is lurking just out of sight.
ARGH! You'll pay for that!
Um... excuse me. I'm just looking to buy some cheap rations and scrap materials...
Do you happen to have anything to spare?
Wait! Please, don't hit the alarm! I'm begging you!
I swear, I have nothing to do with the Resistance anymore! I'm just trying to survive on my own...
If you let me go this once... I-I was still their senior officer! I promise I'll put in a good word for you with the kids!
Thank you so much... Really, bless your kind heart...
Former Lower Level Resistance Leader Apprehended!
In a swift operation by station security, Arthur Lafleur, a known figure and former female leader in the failed resistance movements of the lower levels, has been apprehended.
Keep your hand off the alarm. I prefer not to make a mess.
I am Commander Odin. Odin Haraldsson. Remember that name.
I came here today in good faith to propose a long-term contract.
Sell me out, and you won't just lose your honor—you'll lose your most lucrative buyer.
My unit is currently in dire need of tactical supplies.
Firearms, munitions, armor plating, toxins, supply crates, security keycards—I'll take them all.
I don't care if it's contraband, as long as my people can use it. The payout might not be inflated, but my word is ironclad.
Take this encrypted comm-link card. Call me the moment you have a shipment ready.
Petty, pathetic trick... The cost of betraying me is something you'll learn very soon.
Odin Haraldsson... the insurgent commander herself! We finally got you! Don't move!
I'm here, shopkeeper.
Let's inspect the goods. What have you requisitioned for my unit this time?
Reconfirming specifications: we require weapons, live ammo, armor plates, toxins, supply crates, and security keycards.
Dammit... and here I considered you a respectable partner! You traitor!
Speak. I'm listening.
It's you. Have you secured the supplies we need?
Good. Lock it down in your storage and keep it untouched.
Understood. Schedule confirmed—I will come retrieve the cargo in {0} days.
Our scouts have confirmed what you did behind our backs.
Purge this frequency immediately. Don't force me to send a squad to sanitize your shop.
Our contract is terminated. Watch your back.
Hands where we can see them, Odin! Your little rebellion is over—you are under arrest!
Commander Odin
Can't talk right now. Security's breathing down our necks.
Contact me again once this station crackdown blows over.
Sorry, wrong frequency. [End Call]
Comms out. Stay sharp.
Yahoo~ Well look what we have here, aren't you just the most adorable little Nutrifruit!
The name's Lou! Super pleased to meet ya~
Hmm... I've got this stubborn little "guest," and I'm desperately looking for some fun tools to make him "chat" with a sweet girl like me.
How about a nice heavy iron pipe, a kitchen knife, or ooh... maybe a chunky meat cleaver?
You get it, right? Some people just won't open their precious hearts without a little... gentle encouragement~
So the more wicked little toys you have, the merrier!
Hehe, I'm sure my smart little shopkeeper wouldn't be dumb enough to call Security and get those poor cops slaughtered, right?
So, what's it gonna be, my sweet little Nutrifruit?
Ahahahahaha! Oh my, you actually pressed it?! This is getting so much fun!
Those pathetic little cells won't keep a girl like me locked up for long. *wink*
Keep yourself cute and ready for me, my sweet little Nutrifruit~!
SH-SHIT! It's HER?! The rogue Ghost Commander from Special Ops?!
*Desperately tries to hide their face, terrified of Lou tracking them down later.*
BOO~! Did you jump?!
Teehee, did your poor little heart skip a beat, Nutrifruit?
Did you miss me while I was away?
Calling the cops on a defenseless girl last time wasn't very gentlemanly of you, you bad boy.
At least buy a girl a sweet drink before doing something that dirty~
Anyone else, and I'd have already sliced that pretty face off as a souvenir.
But you... you're either deliciously brave, or adorably stupid.
Either way, I'm in the mood to play some thrilling little games with you.
If you refuse to play with me... well, a smart little guy like you knows what goes boom, right? *chuckles*
Oh, and don't worry! Security won't be interrupting our sweet little dates ever again.
I paid a special midnight visit to the Sector Chief's bedroom last night. He promised to be very, very quiet from now on.
I'll be in touch real soon. See you, cutie~!
Morning, sleepyhead~!
While you were fast asleep, I sneaked a thrilling little present into your inventory piles.
The second midnight strikes, it goes "BOOM~!" into gorgeous fireworks. Tick, tock~!
If you want to wake up and see my pretty face tomorrow, better dig it out before bedtime, Nutrifruit. *wink*
Yahoo~ Nutrifruit! Did you like the little "love-bomb" I left you last night?
Pfft-ahaha! You should've seen your adorable pale face when you found it! Priceless! *chuckles*
Be a good boy and watch over my precious little toy box for a while, will ya?
You'd better not peek at anything inside... or the punishment is going to sting real bad. *wink*
Huh? You didn't even take a tiny little peek?
Aww... such an obedient little boy. You're so sweet I could honestly just gobble you right up.
Naughty little fruits who break promises need to be thoroughly punished. *wink*
Ta-da~! So, what do you think, Nutrifruit? *twirls playfully with hands on hips*
Standard Security uniforms are deathly boring, so I tailored it into this sexy off-shoulder gyaru look just for your eyes. Doesn't it look dangerously hot on me?
Teehee, not like the previous owner has any pulse left to wear clothes anyway. *sticks tongue out and winks*
Spotting me so fast, Nutrifruit? Cute and clever... careful now, a girl might actually fall head-over-heels for you. *wink*
Yahoo~! I'm back! Did you miss your favorite girl while I was gone?
I'll take my precious little toys back now~
Anyway, a girl's got some messy little errands to take care of.
Be good and wait for me, thanks~!
Well well, a curious little Nutrifruit took a sneaky peek inside my box, didn't they?
Oh, don't look so guilty and pale, you naughty little Nutrifruit~
A cute girl's allowed to have her little lethal hobbies, you know.
Maybe next time, I'll personally teach you how to play with them. See you soon! *wink*
See you real soon, Nutrifruit!
Hmm...? Looks like one of my favorite little toys went missing.
Didn't I warn you so gently not to touch a girl's toys, Nutrifruit?
Here's another little present for you. This one's definitely live. Bye-bye~!
Knock knock, Nutrifruit! Did you miss your sweet Lou while I was away?
I'm here to collect my shiny new toys! Weapons, ammo, and meds, {0} Credits' worth.
And don't try to pull a fast one on a sweet girl. I "borrowed" every military scanner Security owns. *wink*
That's not even half of what you owe a girl like me, Nutrifruit.
And here I thought we were having such a delightfully fun time together.
Guess I'll have to settle this debt the classic Special Ops way, then.
Here's one last parting gift for you. This one is 100% real. Bye-bye~! *wink*
I'll gladly take whatever's left in shiny cold cash, then. *wink*
You don't even have that much pocket change? Then I'm scooping up every last credit in your register~
[That's All I Have]
Yay that's every single shiny toy I asked for! Such a good, obedient little Nutrifruit!
Well, playing with you has been an absolute blast! Maybe Lou will sneak back for another visit someday~
Ooh this wicked little thing, I like this one a lot!
Still {0} Credits' worth of goods to go, cutie.
Huh? That's all for a girl like me? You're still {0} Credits short, you know.
Lay them out on the counter whenever you're ready for inspection.
Remember that stubborn little "guest" I mentioned last time? After some sweet persuasion, he finally opened right up.
He coughed up the safehouse of a certain big shot. It's high time I settle an old, bloody score with that bastard.
By the way, when you called Security on me back then, you pocketed that fat bounty all for yourself, didn't you?
So mathematically speaking, you owe a sweet girl like me a huge favor—not to mention emotional damages~
Settling this score takes some lethal new toys, and you're the lucky boy who gets to run errands for me.
Bring me {0} Credits' worth of weapons, ammo, and meds, and we're totally even.
I'll be back in a week to inspect. Don't keep a girl who dressed up just for you waiting, Nutrifruit. *wink*
Pfft-ahaha~! You silly little Nutrifruit, it's me, your girl Lou!
Hahaha! Just because I customized the uniform into a spicy gyaru look, you totally fell for it? You're way too easy!
Hehe, sharp eyes~! You saw right through the spicy officer look I put together just for you.
FREEZE! Rogue Special Ops ghost, you are under arrest!
Then again, sturdy engineering tools would do the trick just as well.
Maybe a scorching plasma cutter, or a nice, slender screwdriver?
Lou's Armed Plastic Explosive
The thrilling "present" Lou hid in your stock. The timer confirms it detonates at midnight. You'd better disarm it before bedtime.
Lou's Prank Plastic Explosive
The mock bomb Lou planted to tease you. Looks frighteningly real, but there's no actual explosive payload inside.
Old Republic Classified Orders
A brittle, faded document, folded and unfolded countless times by Lou's trembling fingers. A ruthless order commanding her squad to commit mass slaughter.
Lou's Secret Box of Toys
A repurposed Security locker covered in cute doodles. If you value your life, you'd better not touch anything inside.
Lou warned you with a smile not to touch her toys. She left another little gift on your counter, and this one was live. The explosion vaporized the store, and you along with it.
You failed to settle your debt with Lou, so she closed the account her own way: a real present ticking on your counter. The blast tore the shop to dust.
Visiting Republic Admiral Gunned Down by Lethal Assassin!

A visiting Republic admiral and his elite escort were gunned down near the docks. Witnesses say the shooter, a blonde woman in stolen Security gear, calmly walked up and eliminated the squad. Despite taking multiple hits, she vanished like a ghost.
Good little Nutrifruits get a treat~ Go on, pick one.
Ooh~ Good choice.
Ooh. Careful with that, Nutrifruit. You only get one shot at me.
AHH!
...Where did you get that?
I know that little toy. Republic issue.
You could have hidden it in my things. You showed it to me instead.
They're coming for me now. Fine. Let them come.
I'm sorry about before. Now I need to ask you for a favor.
I need weapons, ammo, meds. Whatever you can spare. Please.
Put it on the counter. Whatever you can spare.
[That's All I Have]
Good. More, if you've got it.
That'll do. That'll do nicely.
Thanks, Nutrifruit. You'll be hearing from me.
It might not be enough. Not that I'm ungrateful, mind you.
It'll have to do then. Wish me luck, Nutrifruit.
I know a weapons dealer around here. {0} Credits would cover the rest.
[Give her {0} Credits]
Shopkeeper, my team and I have been tracking a woman named Lou for a while now.
We believe you just met her. She's a traitor to the Republic and a terrorist.
Regular Security officers won't be able to hold her.
She'll come back here, and she'll want to play.
She's a psychopath, but a predictable one. Be patient. Play along.
Take this transmitter. Hide it inside something she takes with her. A box, a crate, anything that leaves with her.
Once it reaches her hideout, we move in. There's intel in there the Republic needs recovered.
Help us capture her and {0} Credits are yours. Not a word of this to anyone.
That woman you shot yesterday. You're the first person in years to put a hole in her. Congratulations.
She's a traitor to the Republic and a terrorist. And she never forgives. She'll haunt you.
Your best option is to cooperate with us.
Take this transmitter. She'll come for payback. Whatever she makes you hand over, hide it inside.
{0} Credits now, for your trouble. Another {1} once we have her. Not a word of this to anyone.
It's done. We have her.
The Republic is grateful. Here are your {0} Credits.
She'll rot in a black site for the rest of her life.
It's done. We have her. It cost us two good people.
Somehow she knew we were coming. Funny, that.
Your {0} Credits, as agreed. The Republic keeps its word.
From now on, Security will keep a close eye on this store. Just in case.
I take it you've read the news. A Republic naval admiral, dead on this station.
She did it, and we could have stopped her.
I thought we had an understanding about her.
You're lucky we have to leave soon to track her down, or we'd look deeper into your involvement.
Um... hello there. Please don't be alarmed, my name is Li Bei Wen... I'm a medical researcher.
Please, I beg of you, don't press the alarm... I swear I'm innocent, they've framed me...
They seized my laboratory, but I'm so close to finalizing a new analgesic formula!
It's a non-addictive alternative to Oxymore... It relieves pain without the horrific risk of dependence or overdose!
The mega-pharma cartels profit off chronic addiction... They terrified of this hitting the market, it would ruin their bottom line...
They bribed Station Security... and branded a defenseless researcher like me as an "armed cartel chemist"...
I've completely run out of research funds... I don't even have enough credits for basic chemical reagents.
These are some safe medical samples I managed to formulate in hiding... Could you... please take them? I desperately need your help...
No... please let me go! My reagents! What about the patients who are suffering?! NOOO——!!
Shut your mouth and keep moving, you cartel scum! You're coming with us!
Wait... please, I'm begging you, don't call Security!
If you just let me walk away... once the formula is perfected, I swear I'll share the complete synthesis data with you!
Phew... Hello again, it's me, Li Bei Wen.
Thanks to your shelter, the synthesis is almost complete... but I still urgently need some chemical supplies.
Security patrols are closing in everywhere... Every step outside feels like walking to the gallows.
Please... if you can help me gather the materials, I will gladly share this life-saving formula with you!
Wonderful... this purity is more than enough! Thank you so, so much!
It's okay, please don't apologize... I'll risk coming back in a week. Please keep an eye out for supplies until then.
Thank you from the bottom of my heart... You have no idea what your kindness means. You haven't just saved me—you've given countless dying souls a second chance at life.
Shopkeeper! Look! It worked... I actually finished the formula!
Thank you for believing in me when the whole station was hunting me down... Without you, I would have died alone in those freezing lower ducts.
I managed to secure passage on an outbound smuggler vessel... I'm going to leak the formula open-source to the entire sector. No corporation will ever monopolize pain relief again!
Here is the master formula and all my synthesis notes... Please, keep it safe. It belongs to you as well, my savior.
Do you happen to have any on hand right now? If not... I can risk coming back in a week.
The more supplies you can provide, the sooner I can finish this safe medicine... please.
Please wait for me... the moment the synthesis is successful, I'll return to you.
Li Bei Wen's Nomore Formula
Nomore Injector
A non-addictive pain relief alternative created by Li Bei Wen. Delivers effective analgesia without dependence or overdose risks. A prototype packaged in a repurposed injector.
Step 1: Ingredient Prep
Step 2: Extraction
Step 3: Evaporation
- Gently blend a few Dream Caps into smooth Dream Cap Mush
- Add Alcohol equal to 5 times the volume of Dream Cap Mush\n- Carefully heat the mixture to 40-50C to get clear Dream Cap Extract
- Carefully filter through Kotton Fabric, then place into the Evaporator\n- (REQUIRED) Ensure all water and alcohol have completely evaporated
Step 4: Reaction
- Add Reducing Agent equal to the Dream Cap Extract\n- Gently blend in Lipobond Agent equal to one quarter of the volume\n- Heat mixture carefully to 45-55C to synthesize Nomore
WARNING: DREAM CAP EXTRACT IS DELICATE AND WILL DEGRADE ABOVE 60C!
Step 5: Packaging
- Perform final filtration and evaporate the Lipobond Agent completely\n- Select Nomore Injector in the Chem Finisher to complete packaging
Oh, you did good, Citizen. That woman was dangerous. Very, VERY dangerous.
Um... e-excuse me, Boss! I... I snuck out some clean extra rations from the kitchen, do you buy food here?
They're still warm and fresh, I swear! If you're willing to buy, I-I can sneak out more for you whenever I'm on night shift!
Waaah! Wait, wait, please! Don't hit the alarm, I'm begging you! Please don't call the police!

Uuu... if the supervisor finds out, they'll fire me and throw me out onto the streets! If you just let me go this once... I swear I'll keep bringing you the cheapest, biggest food packs at half price!
Thank you so much... ugh, you're an angel, Boss! I-I swear on my life, you won't regret showing mercy to me!
Phew... I managed to sneak out another bundle while the stock clerk was on break! Still the same sweet discount as last time... w-would you like to take it, Boss?
*Sigh*... Look, shopkeeper, I'm begging you, please keep your hand off that alarm...
It's all because my parents gave me the most ridiculously common name on the entire station,
and those useless paper-pushers at Security completely mixed up their files...
Instead of printing the actual armed robber's mugshot, they put my exhausted employee ID photo on the wanted poster!
Please, have some mercy! I'm just a normal, overworked office lady trying to buy some snacks and go home to sleep!
They've already dragged me into the precinct FOUR times this month alone!!
*Groans*... Again?! Why?! I literally just told you I'm completely innocent...!
Shut it, save the sob story! You're coming with us, Smith!
...It's you. You're the one who slammed that alarm without even blinking, aren't you?
Security kept me locked in a freezing holding cell for two whole days before they finally realized they had the wrong girl.
I explained everything so clearly, and you still sold me out just to pocket a measly bounty!
...Whatever. I'm too exhausted to even argue with you. I just want to buy some damn food.
I have plenty of credits. So, dear shopkeeper, can I FINALLY buy something to eat this time?
AGAIN?! Haah... on what charges?! What did I do in my past life to deserve this torment?!
Oh~ Good morning! How do you like the lovely fresh red paint job across your storefront?
That's your divine retribution for constantly throwing an innocent, hardworking salarywoman into jail, scum boss.
Have fun scrubbing every single letter off, hope your back hurts. Bye.
Hey, wait! Officers, you know me! I was literally released from your station two days ago! You've got the wrong girl!
Quiet down! No mix-up this time—you're under arrest for municipal vandalism! Let's go!
Your store was vandalized overnight. A grudge-filled "JOHN SMITH" was spray-painted across the front in giant red letters.
Ugh... what a total drag! And after I spent all morning ironing this ceremonial uniform to look utterly majestic...
FREEZE! Forging gold tassels and impersonating a Senior Security Inspector is a massive felony!
Where on earth did you even steal this ridiculous gold-braided parade uniform from?! Start talking, you little cosplaying brat!
Stay calm. Please. Don't... panic.
This is a routine security inspection. Routine. Very routine.
This one's... special. Orders from upstairs.
So, uh. Open your cargo hold and step aside. Quick, before my shift... I mean, before my shift ends.
Wanted Girls
Odin: holy light over chest
When on, a white light covers the right side of Odin's chest (portrait and WANTED board). Off shows the original art. Applies to all saves.
Listen up, darling. Let big sister walk you through how things work down here.
This little sector of ours is a delicate ecosystem, you see.
If someone takes too much without giving a single thing back...
The balance shatters, and the whole house of cards comes crashing down.
Play your cards right, and I'd love to do you some favors. In return...
You look out for my Lower Levels folks from time to time, deal?
Here, take my personal card. Keep it close.
Whenever you're in over your head, just give me a ring.
Well hello there, shopkeeper. It's been a while since I heard your voice.
Dr. Jackson was just pouting to me that you haven't dropped by his place either.
Just a gentle reminder, darling: whenever you need a hand, I'm right here.
Come closer. Take a look at the little treats I've put together for you.
Oh my... word on the street is you've hit a bit of a rough patch.
Charming local shops like yours are the beating heart of our community, you know.
Chin up, sweetheart. I'm throwing a few favors your way—on the house.
Here. Don't let me down now, okay?
Hey there, neighbor! Did you forget how to dial, or are you just playing hard to get?
Ring me up when you get a second. I don't bite... much.
My rolodex is packed with all sorts of delightful, capable folks.
Farming, purifying water, distilling fine moonshine... just say the word, and I'll make the introductions.
Just punch my number whenever you're ready, darling.
Ah... hello there.
I'm afraid I come with some rather heartbreaking news.
You were quite fond of Grandpa Cheng, weren't you?
Last night... the old man slipped away peacefully in his sleep.
He had a golden heart. A true cornerstone of our Lower Levels family.
He left something behind. I want you to have it, to remember him by.
Well, well, look at my star player! Good news travels fast.
This whole place is officially in your hands now. Congratulations! That's quite a feat down here.
Since you've proven yourself a truly capable merchant, I've got something exclusive for you.
Ever heard whispers about... "Hypertech"?
Miraculous stuff, darling. Far beyond anything the crude factories on this station could ever dream of making.
Even the high-and-mighty up in the Upper Levels would claw each other's eyes out for it.
I know a smuggler who dances in those shadows. I can make an introduction—for a rather handsome fee, of course.
But a fair warning from me first: every single step down that road will cost a pretty penny.
Once your nerves and your wallet are ready, give me a call.
[Browse Ms. Wild's Services]
Hello, this is Ms. Wild's private office...
How may we be of service to you today, dear?
Here is what we can arrange for you at the moment.
Ahem... Citizen, attention! This is Officer Lun from the Security Department!
I am currently on a very serious, top-priority sector patrol...!
The thing is... um... I left my lunchbox at home in a rush... Do you have anything edible here? whimpers
Wah, a lifesaver! I-I'll accept this under official requisition orders...!
Dummy! My stomach is growling here, that's not something you can eat...!
nom nom... Hmph, good citizen. I'll let your minor infractions slide today!
Help, somebody help meee! Boss! Give me some neural painkillers or whatever you've got, right now!
It hurts so bad...! Some jerk in a grey jumpsuit jumped me in the alley...!
I don't care if it's black-market contraband! Just shoot me with the strongest dose you have, please... it hurts so much...!
Shh... this is completely off the books! Internal Affairs can NEVER find out about this, got it...?!
Yes... that's it... Th-Thank you so much, sniff...
Wah! Not that! I'm seeing stars here, give me something that stops the pain!
Eep! Who cares if it's unregistered contraband, as long as it works! Give it here!
sniff... Ahhh... I think the feeling is coming back... I almost became a line-of-duty casualty, geez...!
Um... Boss... I, uh, "accidentally" stumbled across some gear during patrol...
A-Are you buying? C'mon, give a girl a decent price, we're buddies, right...?
Yay! D-Deal! Remember, you never got this from me, okay?!
Eh? Wait... wait a sec! What are you guys doing here?!
Hey! That's the scumbag who ambushed Officer Lun!
Grab him! Don't let him get away!
Wahhh?! This is the absolute worst!
Heheh, salute! See that? Officer Lun is officially back on duty, fully recovered!
That was just a little paid vacation in the Medbay, that's all... I totally didn't cry for my mommy!
Don't panic, don't panic! This is just a completely normal routine check-in.
Since I'm already here... could you slip me some of those heavy-duty painkillers?
The extra-strength kind, please... The stitches still sting sometimes, you know...
Just for the record! It's purely for emergency reserves! I am definitely not getting dependent on them, okay?!
Hehe, deal! Tucked safely inside my sleeves where nobody can see~
Wah, thanks a million... High-grade neural injectors like this cost a fortune. You're actually really sweet...!
No, no, no! I asked for neuro-blocker painkillers! What did you just hand me?!
S-Synaprest?! Do you... do you think I've got a substance problem?! I don't!
And even if I did... with my pathetic patrol stipend, I could never afford this stuff anyway, sniff...
Works for me! Quick, shove it up my sleeve... I'll take it!
Mmhmm, looks legit! Now I can finally finish patrol without wincing!
Shh—hey! Keep it down, little boss, it's your absolute lucky day!
Requisition just authorized the release of some... cough, 'surplus tactical assets'!
Well? I smuggled them straight here just for you. Interested?
But pinky promise first! Strictly confidential between us, not a peep to anyone!
If you take the whole batch, I'm authorized to give you 33% off! Pretty sweet deal, huh!
Splendid! You're a lifesaver... the ledger might actually balance now!
Waaah?! W-Wait! Why are Internal Affairs here...?!
Officer Lun? What in the world are you doing skulking around that counter?
Found them! This is the missing gear flagged from the Armory!
W-Wait, I can explain! I just brought them out for anti-rust maintenance... it wasn't black-marketing, I swear!
Come quietly, Officer Lun. You know what happens if you resist the inspectorate.
Ahem! Freeze! S-Surprise inspection! Routine security check!
Open up the safe, right now! No stalling, I can be very tough if I have to!
Hmph! Caught red-handed! Unregistered controlled neuro-stims detected. Confiscating them this instant!
Don't you pout at me! You should be grateful I didn't slap cuffs on you and drag you to the station!
